intent: REFACTOR IngestTelemetryService: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Telemetry Intake & Validation use case implementing IngestTelemetryUseCase. Constructor IngestTelemetryService(SensorMetricBoundaryPolicy policy, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetrySampleEvent> validatedSamples). Every sample is validated before propagation; each is mapped to TelemetrySampleEvent (status string VALID or VALIDATION_FAILED) and published in packet order with concatMap (TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed). Invalid samples are tagged, never dropped. Channel overflow error propagates to the caller (backpressure). No blocking calls.
